priority_rebuild_candidates.reason: Umbrella source material contains useful evidence, scoring, runtime, and reporting ideas, but must be reduced to runtime-neutral discipline rules before activation.
Broad SEO, AEO, GEO, schema, architecture, and strategy material is useful as reference, but volatile claims require source-tier labels and current verification.
The router pattern, report discovery flow, do-not-claim rules, and eval style are strong architecture references, but the package should not become the vault's canonical SEO behavior wholesale.
Broad deterministic check inventory is useful for page and site audit implementation after the foundation gate exists.
Wrapper shape, smoke tests, cache contracts, and environment verification are useful references, but the package is runtime-shaped.
Post-writing SEO validation contains useful on-page checks, but universal thresholds and blog-only assumptions must become mode-aware.
JSON-LD generation workflow is useful, but schema facts, platform support, and rich-result claims require current verification.
Keyword and cluster planning workflow is useful, but connected-tool assumptions must move to tool metadata and approval gates.
Overlap detection is useful, but semantic similarity must not be treated as SERP proof without provider or first-party evidence.
